root_cause: The checkboxes component lacks logic to handle the `data-checkbox-exclusive` attribute. When a checkbox with `data-checkbox-exclusive` is checked, it should uncheck all other checkboxes in the same `data-checkbox-exclusive-group`, but the current implementation does not enforce this mutual exclusion.
repair_strategy: Update the checkboxes component's change event handler to detect exclusive checkboxes. When an exclusive checkbox becomes checked, find all other checkboxes with the same `data-checkbox-exclusive-group` value and uncheck them, then trigger their change events to keep form state consistent.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now reliably select 'No, I do not have any of these symptoms' after ticking other symptoms, and the exclusive option will correctly clear previous selections, matching the expected form behavior and preventing contradictory submissions.
functional_risks: If the component is used without a group attribute, the fallback unchecks all checkboxes in the container, which may affect unrelated groups.
Dispatching synthetic change events may trigger duplicate handlers if not idempotent.
verification_requirements: Run the frozen journey: tab to cough, space, tab to fever, space, tab to none, space — verify symptoms[cough] and symptoms[fever] are cleared.
Test mouse/touch interaction on the exclusive checkbox.
Verify contact checkboxes (different group) still work independently.
Check that unchecking the exclusive checkbox does not re-enable others automatically.
